Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for the demo today — great conversation. This note captures the agreed success criteria, proposed evaluation plan, and an initial timeline so we can lock in owners and kickoff next week. Please reply with any edits or confirmations.

Summary / Success criteria (as discussed)
- Integrations: Redwood inference API integrates with ACME's staging environment (model endpoint + auth)
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end generation < 350ms for 512-token prompts
- Cost: achieve per-request cost within agreed budget window (TBD in pricing follow-up)
- Quality: human-evaluated pass rate >= 85% for the provided prompt set

Evaluation plan
- Week 0 (prep): Redwood provides POC template + eval checklist (attached) and access details; ACME supplies sample prompt set and representative dataset
- Week 1-2 (integration): Dev integration + smoke tests; weekly check-in on Thursdays
- Week 3 (load & regression): run scaled inference runs and measure latency/cost; collect evaluation labels
- Week 4 (readout): final readout with metrics, recordings, and next-step recommendation

Owners / roles
- Redwood PM: Marissa Cole (project lead, weekly check-ins)
- Redwood Eng: Dev Patel (integration, infra support)
- ACME Eng: Sam Torres (integration engineer)
- ACME Product: Priya Shah (success criteria & signoff)

Proposed kickoff: Monday, 28 June at 10:00 AM PT — please confirm availability.

Attachments: redwood-poc-template.pdf, evaluation-checklist.xlsx, networking-checklist.txt

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick technical follow-up ahead of kickoff: 

- Networking: for the staging integration we'll need the following IP allowlist entries (small set) — I'll paste the exact CIDRs in the calendar invite. The networking-checklist.txt attached lists the optional ports and AWS region notes.
